basic.name: Diagnostic Kick
basic.description_template: Deals Lightning DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Bailu's ATK to a single enemy.

skill.name: Singing Among Clouds
skill.description_template: Heals a single ally for {{scaling1}}% of Bailu's Max HP plus {{scaling2}}. Bailu then heals random allies 2 time(s). After each healing, HP restored from the next healing is reduced by 15%.

ultimate.name: Felicitous Thunderleap
ultimate.description_template: Heals all allies for {{scaling1}}% of Bailu's Max HP plus {{scaling2}}. Bailu applies Invigoration to allies that are not already Invigorated. For those already Invigorated, Bailu extends the duration of their Invigoration by 1 turn. The effect of Invigoration can last for 2 turn(s). This effect cannot stack.

talent.name: Gourdful of Elixir
talent.description_template: After an ally target with Invigoration is hit, restores the ally's HP for {{scaling1}}% of Bailu's Max HP plus {{scaling2}}. This effect can trigger 2 time(s). When Bailu's teammate receives a killing blow, they will not be knocked down. Bailu immediately heals the ally for {{scaling3}}% of Bailu's Max HP plus {{scaling4}} HP. This effect can be triggered 1 time per battle.

technique.name: Saunter in the Rain
technique.description: After Technique is used, at the start of the next battle, all allies are granted Invigoration for 2 turn(s).

2.name: Qihuang Analects
2.description: When Bailu heals a target ally above their normal Max HP, the target's Max HP increases by 10% for 2 turns.

6.name: Aquatic Benediction
6.description: Characters with Invigoration receive 10% less DMG.

eidolons.name: Ambrosial Aqua
eidolons.description: If the target ally's current HP is equal to their Max HP when Invigoration ends, regenerates 8 extra Energy for this target.

eidolons.name: Sylphic Slumber
eidolons.description: After using her Ultimate, Bailu's Outgoing Healing increases by an additional 15% for 2 turn(s).

eidolons.name: Omniscient Opulence
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: Evil Excision
eidolons.description: Every healing provided by the Skill makes the recipient deal 10% more DMG for 2 turn(s). This effect can stack up to 3 time(s).

eidolons.name: Waning Worries
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: Drooling Drop of Draconic Divinity
eidolons.description: Bailu can heal allies who received a killing blow 1 more time(s) in a single battle.
